the effects of team-teaching on the achievement and selected attitudes of ninth grade students.
the effects of a team teaching approach on student achievement and attitudes after one year of instruction.
the effects of team-teaching on the attitudes and achievement of high school students.

team teaching has a significant impact on the attitudes of students, but not their achievement.
team teaching is a viable instructional technique for use in the classroom, but it is not a panacea for all of the ills of the educational process.
